verdict.rationale: Langfuse provides native SDKs for Python/JS, used to capture traces, query APIs, and manage prompts, plus 100+ framework integrations and OTel support — clear evidence of official SDK-based development. Community feedback corroborates strong DX/integration quality, though some note prompt-management API limitations. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of SDK completeness/performance and broader language SDK coverage beyond Python/JS.
